summary.text: Kevin Daley is a Republican member of the Michigan Senate representing District 26, which covers portions of Lapeer, Tuscola, Genesee and Saginaw counties.
His Senate biography describes him as a fifth-generation Lapeer County farmer and a lifetime resident of the district.

paragraphs.text: Daley began his public service on the Arcadia Township planning commission and went on to serve as trustee, treasurer and township supervisor.
He was first elected to the Michigan House in 2008 and represented the 82nd District in Lapeer County until 2014, chairing the House Agriculture Committee.
In 2018 he was elected to represent the 31st Senate District, which then included Bay, Lapeer and Tuscola counties, and he was selected to chair the Senate Agriculture Committee.

His memberships include the Lapeer County Farm Bureau, the Sunrise Lapeer Kiwanis Club and the National Rifle Association, and he is a former president of the Tri-County Michigan Milk Producers Association.
Daley lives in Lapeer County with his wife, Debbie, a retired elementary school teacher; they have three children and eight grandchildren.
